_why: v3.71 — 131 is `undesigned`: a hex in NO design token. It rose from 108 because the scanner got honest, not because anyone added a colour. It looked only inside <style>, which is one of the three places a single-file HTML app paints; it now also reads inline style="" attributes and SVG/HTML paint attributes, including the ones assembled inside JavaScript strings, which is where a surprising amount of this product's colour lives. That surfaced 23 literals nothing had ever counted. `unmigrated` (a hex that IS a token, written as a literal instead of var(--…)) is 81 and is still not ratcheted here — mechanical, and letting it in would mean a palette edit could erase violations with no CSS improving. It was 68 and wrong in both directions: it counted `--token: #hex` definitions, which cannot become a var() reference to themselves, and it missed every usage outside a stylesheet. In video_review.html that was the whole number — three counted, all three definitions, and seven real usages in JS-built SVG invisible. Raise it again only with a reason here.
